steps.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Final modular TMT office overview design, 1536x1024 landscape. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. Crisp small pixel clusters with refined authored shading, not flat vector rectangles, not photorealism. Same camera, light from upper-left, no perspective convergence, no gritty noise. High back walls, genuinely thick side walls, low front sill for visibility. All image text English. Source is style reference, not an edit target. No arbitrary freeform terrain or 6x4 brush.
Reinterpret reference as a precise buildable modular set. Main deck LEFT is rectangle with four identical private office modules, two top and two bottom; two-module-wide Lobby in center row. Lobby contains deep green sofa + two armchairs + coffee table, public discussion board and broadcast radio. Each office has one desk, monitor, chair, bookcase, plant, rug, separate wall window and wall sconce. Friendly small robots with nameplates Alice, Bob, Casey, Dana; contractor Pip in lobby. Make all four office footprints identical. High thick partition back walls as tall as exterior back wall, low foreground sills, real open doorways facing the lobby, not painted door symbols.
Separate meeting wing RIGHT connected by narrow illuminated horizontal bridge, two identical vertically stacked meeting modules with oval conference tables and six green chairs each, whiteboard. Corridor on wing left allows room access. At wing end show one cyan ghost-module card with plus and "Add meeting room". Empty space for additional office modules outside main deck.
Floating small top-left "tmt office"; top-right "-  Fit  +"; only small bottom-left "Build" button. No sidebar, NO editing toolbar, no selected rectangle, no extra panels. Office-centered edge-to-edge world. Thin quiet star field. No baked readable prose on furniture; actual UI labels sharp. Keep same cozy material richness and thick chamfered stone silhouette as reference. Small bottom-right "VISUAL TARGET · NOT A RUNTIME SCREENSHOT".

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this office overview only. Preserve camera, exact office+Lobby+meeting layout, thick walls, every furniture piece and robot, names, bridge, colors, upper-left tmt office heading, Fit controls, bottom-left Build button and footer.
REMOVE the two cyan PLUS ghost pads floating on the FAR LEFT outside the main building (one at upper left and one lower left), replacing them entirely with continuous matching quiet starfield. This is browse mode; no private-office expansion slots should show. KEEP the cyan "Add meeting room" affordance beneath the right meeting wing unchanged. Also change radio screen text from "ON AIR" to "OFF AIR" because nothing is being broadcast. Make no other changes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: architectural modular game-art source sheet, transparent background. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. Crisp small pixel clusters with refined authored shading, not flat vector rectangles, not photorealism. Same camera, light from upper-left, no perspective convergence, no gritty noise. High back walls, genuinely thick side walls, low front sill for visibility. All image text English. Source is style reference, not an edit target. No arbitrary freeform terrain or 6x4 brush.
Produce a square 2048x2048 sheet of exactly 16 isolated architecture pieces arranged in a uniform 4 by 4 grid. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no typography, no sheet labels, no floor under unrelated pieces, no cast shadows outside cells. Every piece fully inside its equal cell with wide clear margins. Same scale and camera throughout.
Row1 left to right: (1) long horizontal tall ivory plaster wall with thick chamfered teal upper crown and brass skirting, empty without furniture; (2) matching long horizontal low front sill exposing thick top plane; (3) full-height LEFT side-wall segment receding vertically, visible inward face and thick top; (4) matching RIGHT side-wall segment, consistent upper-left light.
Row2: (5) chunky convex outside corner pillar; (6) concave inside corner connection; (7) T-junction pillar/cap; (8) four-way intersection cap.
Row3: (9) front-facing OPEN door portal, two thick jambs and top lintel, genuinely transparent passage all the way to bottom, no plaster blocking opening; (10) side-facing open doorway; (11) oak floor tile patch with no borders; (12) corridor oak floor inset between low teal edges.
Row4: (13) horizontal connector bridge with thin brass edge lights; (14) vertical connector bridge; (15) L-bend corridor; (16) T-junction corridor. All art faces mechanically attachable in same orthographic cutaway game. No windows lamps plants robots baked into wall components. Detailed pixels, rich amber wood and beveled teal structure, NOT chunky low-detail geometric placeholders. This is the reusable architecture kit behind the reference office.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the attached 4x4 architecture asset sheet. Preserve exact 16 pieces, camera, composition, cell positions, silhouettes, rich materials and genuine transparent background. Remove ALL attached yellow glowing sconces/lamps and their glows from tall plaster wall in row1 col1, both side walls row1 col3 and col4, and door portals row3 col1 and col2. Fill those spots with uninterrupted matching plain ivory plaster/trim. Wall/door pieces must have NO lights or windows baked in. Retain tiny structural edge lights on the two detached bridge pieces in row4 col1 and col2 ONLY. Keep door holes truly transparent, floor patch unchanged. No text, no new objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: furniture source sprite sheet. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. High back walls, genuinely thick side walls, low front sill for visibility. All image text English. Source is style reference, not an edit target. No arbitrary freeform terrain or 6x4 brush. Create a square 2048x2048 transparent PNG containing exactly SIXTEEN isolated individual furniture assets in four even rows and four columns, clear separation and margins, no labels or text. Match attached architectural material reference. This is NOT an assembled room.
Row1: polished oak work desk empty surface with drawer; desktop monitor with separate small keyboard as one unit; tall oak bookcase full of books; freestanding brass reading lamp.
Row2: four matching deep-green upholstered office chairs, facing south/toward viewer, west/left, north/away, east/right respectively. All same scale, distinct correctly drawn orientations, not just rotate flat sprite.
Row3: green three-seat sofa; green armchair; oval wood coffee table EMPTY top; larger oval wood CONFERENCE TABLE EMPTY top with visible thick edge and sturdy legs, NO chairs attached.
Row4: terracotta pot with leafy green indoor plant; green woven rectangular rug with gold trim; blue woven rectangular rug with gold trim; terracotta woven rectangular rug with gold trim.
Authentic transparent background, no checkerboard, no walls, no people, no floor surrounding items. Fine detailed pixel edges and authored material highlights. Shadows only tiny contact shadows belonging to each asset. Never crop objects. Upper-left lighting consistent. Furniture is separate so user can rearrange every item.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: mounted objects and functional-prop source sprite sheet. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Square 2048x2048 genuine transparent PNG, exactly 16 isolated assets in uniform 4 rows by 4 columns, generous margins, no grid or labels, no words. Same camera and upper-left light as reference. Do NOT draw walls behind any asset.
Row1: wide brass-framed observatory WINDOW front-facing with dark starfield and blue planet; same window oriented for LEFT side wall; same window oriented for RIGHT side wall; single separate brass WALL SCONCE with warm light.
Row2: small ornate framed blank ivory POSTER; dark teal horizontal blank room-name SIGN with brass rim; narrow blank dark agent-name PLAQUE; oak wall SHELF holding a few books, no external wall.
Row3: wide brass-framed blank WHITEBOARD with marker tray; cork DISCUSSION BOARD with four blank pinned paper notes, clearly different from whiteboard; compact oak-and-teal BROADCAST RADIO console with microphone and dark blank indicator panel; closed leather NOTEBOOK.
Row4: open cream-page NOTEBOOK; ivory coffee MUG; tiny green desk PLANT in terracotta pot; isolated soft warm amber elliptical LIGHT GLOW fading fully to transparent, no hard perimeter.
No text baked in artwork: editable names, board contents and radio state are rendered by app. Functional props are visible rich physical furniture, no fake action icons baked in. Not a scene, not a mockup, no robot. Keep pixel-game craftsmanship matching thick teal/ivory/oak architecture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: robot avatar source sprite sheet. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. Crisp small pixel clusters with refined authored shading, not flat vector rectangles, not photorealism. Same camera, light from upper-left, no perspective convergence, no gritty noise. High back walls, genuinely thick side walls, low front sill for visibility. All image text English. Source is style reference, not an edit target. No arbitrary freeform terrain or 6x4 brush. Square 2048x2048 transparent PNG, exactly 16 small friendly robot figures in strict 4x4 cells. Each whole body fully visible with wide margins, NO background, NO labels, NO furniture, no shadow floor. Consistent compact cute silhouette: large rounded ivory helmet, glossy almost-black faceplate with two softly luminous cream eyes, short ivory body, rounded arms, short sturdy feet, small color accent panels. Match robots in office style reference, not industrial humanoids, not animal pets.
Each ROW is same robot accent variant: row1 moss green, row2 muted sky blue, row3 terracotta orange, row4 lilac violet.
Each COLUMN is orientation: column1 facing SOUTH toward viewer; column2 facing WEST left profile; column3 facing NORTH back of head and body, no eyes on back; column4 facing EAST right profile.
All sixteen are neutral idle standing, same scale and anatomy. Use refined coherent pixel-game shading, warm upper-left highlight. Accents only on small body/ear panels, keep most shell ivory. No ears/hair/tail, no text. Maintain recognizable black faceplate and eye style. This is static directional art, not movement animation or a sitting sprite.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: material-theme comparison and visual assembly specification. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. Crisp small pixel clusters with refined authored shading, not flat vector rectangles, not photorealism. Same camera, light from upper-left, no perspective convergence, no gritty noise. High back walls, genuinely thick side walls, low front sill for visibility. All image text English. Source is style reference, not an edit target. No arbitrary freeform terrain or 6x4 brush.
Landscape 1536x1024 design board, three equal side-by-side columns on quiet deep navy. Title "One module · Three material skins". Each column shows THE EXACT SAME empty open-front office shell, same dimensions, same camera, same two side walls, same thick upper back wall, same centered OPEN door portal, same floor plank positions, same connection points. No furniture or robots. Use the attached clean architecture kit as strict geometry and silhouette reference, not redesign.
Column1 "Workshop": default desaturated teal chamfered crowns, ivory plaster, amber oak floor, brass trim.
Column2 "Moonlight": blue-slate crowns, cool pale plaster, desaturated pale ash floor, satin silver trim.
Column3 "Copper": warm dark bronze crowns, sand plaster, walnut floor, restrained copper trim.
Below each shell show a neat strip of four material swatches labelled "Wall", "Trim", "Floor", "Metal", colored to match.
Bottom shows a compact repeated connector set in all three palettes: straight wall, corner, open doorway, bridge. Geometry is exactly invariant across skins. Small caption "Appearance changes. Footprints, doors and bindings stay the same." and "VISUAL TARGET · NOT RUNTIME". Crisp intentional pixel-game textures, thick dimensional wall faces, no excessive glows. No floor plan editing panels, no text overflow.

Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. Landscape 2048x1536, four equal panels in clean 2x2 grid, each a close-up of the SAME office adjoining Lobby, with empty starfield beside it. Use exact cozy architecture, tall teal cap/plaster walls and robot furniture from reference. Small English title per panel, fully readable UI. Dark navy floating HUD, cream text, cyan allowed state, amber protected state. No persistent sidebar, no freeform brush, no Zone or Add floor, no 6x4 sizing.
Panel1 top-left heading "1 · Add office": existing room and Lobby at right, ONE equally sized cyan ghost office aligned to adjacent slot at left, genuine snapped full-room footprint with doors/corridor preview. Small anchored card "New office", text field "Name" filled "Workshop", selector "Resident · Unassigned", buttons "Cancel" and "Add to draft". Bottom compact toolbar Select / Add office / Remove / Style / Walls / Furniture, Add office highlighted.
Panel2 top-right "2 · Remove safely": same furnished room selected amber, robot Alice still present, anchored card "Office 01", "Move or remove 8 objects first.", "Alice will return to Lobby.", button "Review objects"; dangerous Remove disabled. No removal has happened, no giant red crossed tile brush.
Panel3 bottom-left "3 · Change material": same room cyan selected, same furniture in same positions, small anchored "Room style" panel with three thumbnail material swatches labelled Workshop / Moonlight / Copper, Workshop selected. Note "Layout unchanged". Show thick wall materials clearly.
Panel4 bottom-right "4 · Place a wall object": same room close-up high back wall, separate framed poster held in cyan snap preview on wall beside a window, small rotate/move/remove floating object controls; unobstructed real doorway. Bottom right Undo / Redo / Cancel / Save. Tiny status "Unsaved changes".
Small overall footer "VISUAL TARGET · NOT RUNTIME". Do not imply room/resource edits saved until Save. All panels are one world-based editor, not unrelated camera styles.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: meeting room interaction final design storyboard. Polished cozy pixel-game diorama, straight-on orthographic cutaway seen slightly from above, never diamond isometric. Dark navy space background, warm amber oak floor, ivory plaster, thick chamfered desaturated teal wall caps, brass sconces, deep green fabric, ivory friendly robot bodies with glossy dark faces. Crisp small pixel clusters with refined authored shading, not flat vector rectangles, not photorealism. Same camera, light from upper-left, no perspective convergence, no gritty noise. High back walls, genuinely thick side walls, low front sill for visibility. All image text English. Source is style reference, not an edit target. No arbitrary freeform terrain or 6x4 brush.
Create landscape 2048x1536 four equal panels (2x2), readable English, same room style and camera. Each panel shows the separate meeting wing with a small piece of Lobby and connecting bridge visible on LEFT, enough world context. Keep fixed-size modules, no movement animation. Dark navy compact HUD overlay, not white web dashboard. High thick ivory and teal walls, oval oak table, green chairs.
Top-left title "1 · First meeting room": NO existing meeting rooms. End of Lobby bridge terminates at a cyan dashed room-sized ghost pad with large plus "Create meeting room". This is an affordance, not an already created room.
Top-right "2 · Name the room": same empty ghost pad, anchored compact card "New meeting room", label "Name", input "Design review", buttons "Cancel" and "Create". NO created meeting behind the form. Name required; cancel creates nothing.
Bottom-left "3 · Add participants": ONE finished meeting room titled "Design review". Table and six chairs. Small robot Alice by table with nameplate. Anchored "Participants" card with Alice checked, Bob unchecked, Pip unchecked; button "Save members". Small second compact tooltip attached to Alice says "Add to meeting…" to show alternate entry. Membership not physical walking.
Bottom-right "4 · Remove from map": SAME finished furnished meeting, amber outline. Anchored card "Remove from map?", "Design review", concise "Move or remove furnishings first.", "Room history and membership are kept.", disabled "Remove module" and active "Cancel". Small secondary text "Close room is a separate action." NO permanently destructive trash icon and no fake removed room. Add meeting room plus remains at end of wing when space permits.
Small footer "VISUAL TARGET · NOT RUNTIME". No freeform tools, no all-office broadcast, no full-page modal, no large sidebar.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached four-panel meeting workflow. Preserve the four-panel composition, all English UI text/cards, bottom-two panels, Lobby snippets, characters, typography, and palette. Change ONLY the meeting area in the TOP TWO panels: it is NOT BUILT YET. Replace all opaque brown floor, thick solid walls, lamps, and plants on the right side of the bridge with a fully translucent CYAN HOLOGRAPHIC OUTLINE of ONE empty meeting module floating over visible dark starfield. The ghost is the same module size and location as the original room, but transparent with fine grid and wireframe walls, no physical furniture/windows/lights. Retain the plus "Create meeting room" in panel1, and the compact "New meeting room" name-entry card in panel2. Make it unmistakable that no room exists until Create. Nothing else changes.
